title: bardolier volumes orphaned output
description: Everything no current project manifest claims, with sizes: named volumes, and projects' leftover data directories (phase 19). cli-spec.md §6 (Volumes / disk). Read-only (§2). Additive changes only once the app ships (Phase 5+).

orphaned.description: Reclaimable volumes and data directories, sorted by name.

total_bytes.description: Sum of size_bytes — what reclaiming all of them would free.

unverified_roots.description: Roots this scan skipped named-volume claims for — unreadable and never indexed (phase 27). Present only when non-empty; directory orphans above are unaffected.

name.description: A Docker volume name, or <project>/<key> for a data directory.

kind.description: What reclaiming this destroys: a Docker named volume, or a project's leftover data directory (phase 19). Absent means volume.

path.description: Host path of a directory orphan; null for a named volume. Additive since phase 19.

last_project.description: Owning project — the volume's bardolier.project label, or the project the data directory sits in — or null when it can't be attributed.
